description: This file contains Bitbake recipe override functions written in Python, used to customize build configurations for an embedded Linux SDK environment. It includes functions to modify configuration files, manage build layers, and handle specific machine overrides.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Prepares the SDK environment by writing to the 'templateconf.cfg' file if it exists.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes the 'templateconf.cfg' file if certain machine overrides are present to prevent build issues.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Adds a generic layer to the build system for specific machine overrides.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies build configuration files, copies kernel images for specific machines, and appends environment variables for the SDK build process.
